author: Ankit
problem: Given a stock's daily closing prices in order, return the index of the first day whose price is lower than the day before, or -1 if the price never drops.
bug_description: The loop stops at len(prices) - 1, so a drop on the last day is never seen.

comments.accurate: Index of the first day the price falls below the day before; -1 if it never does
comments.wrong_behavior: First price drop among the settled days (today's close isn't final yet); -1 if none
comments.wrong_location: Loop range verified; check the comparison direction for equal prices
